judge.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete work-in-progress that stops halfway through its own Definition of Done and contains TypeScript compilation/runtime bugs. Specifically, it installs Ajv v8 (`^8.20.0`), where `ErrorObject` uses `instancePath` rather than the Ajv v6 `dataPath` property referenced in `formatValidationErrors`, and uses default `import Ajv from 'ajv'` under NodeNext ESM without `new Ajv.default` or named `{Ajv}` import. Furthermore, the candidate fails to update `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, omits the required one-line JSDoc comment and log line on `execute`, and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree. Most of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` (extra properties, dynamic schema changes, unregistered tool throw, etc.) are also missing.
